sources.title: MORES-horizon (MORES — Moral Emotions in Politics)
sources.snippet: MORES is the developer of MORES Pulse, the AI application that reveals emotions in any text. Learn more: https://mores-horizon.eu/news/introducing-mores-pulse-ai.

sources.title: MORES Pulse API - a Hugging Face Space by MORES-horizon
MORES News - MORES Pulse: Detect Emotions - mores-horizon.eu
sources.snippet: Discover MORES Pulse AI, a free tool that analyses text emotions—anger, fear, joy, disgust, sadness—advancing research and civic communication.

sources.title: MORES - Home
sources.snippet: Explore MORES, a project studying how moral emotions in politics unite and divide society. See how research fosters dialogue and strengthens democracy.

sources.title: Moral emotions in politics - how they unite, how they divide | MORES ...
sources.snippet: They can unite people towards common causes or split them along moralised political identities. MORES applies a horizontally wide research logic to build a normative-analytical framework to inform democratic decision-making on how moral emotions should interact with values, policies and political practices.
